main_text.head: Nob. Viro, CONSTANTINO L'EMPEREVR, Theologo, Hebraicæ & Chaldaicæ linguæ Pro-fessori, collegæ conjunctissimo.

p.i: TU quoque sancta pijs reseras delubra; virumque, Quem gemino reddis nomine, vita refert. Flavia gens potuit Solymorum accendere templum. Es CONSTANTINVS: cur Titus esse velis? Cæsareum non est ædes excindere sacras. Christiadis illas pandere, Cæsareum est.

page.notes: No page number, running head, catchword or signature is printed on this page. The faint, inverted "DANIEL HEINSIVS" near the lower centre and the faint mirrored lines around the verse are show-through from the other side of the leaf and are left out. The initial "TU" is a large T followed by a small-capital V. The Hebrew word is transcribed as printed, right-aligned at the lower right. The verse is copied as one stanza, as the printer set it.
